text: やせいの　ポケモンが　でて　きても　そいつを　たたかわせて　いけば　となりまちへ　いける！

structure.jp: やせいの　ポケモンが
たたかわせて　いけば

patterns.name: 〜ても
patterns.explanation: て-form plus も means even if. でてきても = 'even if they come out'.

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.span: たたかわせて　いけば
patterns.explanation: ば means if; the result follows. ていく means keep doing from now on. たたかわせていけば = 'if you keep making it fight'.

patterns.name: 〜せる
patterns.explanation: せる makes someone do something. たたかわせる = 'make fight, battle with'.
